ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels, estimated at approximately 98:2 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark field with sparse, non-contiguous high-contrast white punctate markings and thin linear streaks distributed across both lobes. No macro-level mottling or large geometric white blobs are detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central lobe convergence with a pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks. A distinct, deep indentation is visible on the distal margin of the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, light-colored linear pixel disruptions; notably a series of vertically-oriented parallel lines on the lower right lobe and scattered horizontal marks on the mid-left lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright, high-intensity white vertical mark on the leading edge of the far-left distal tip.
